# Sky, space & geo data

Accurate night skies, satellites and Starlink, air traffic, weather, maps and globes, and timeline/graph visualisation. Data licences (ODbL, OpenSky, ADS-B Exchange) are called out per row.

Stars checked 2026-09-23. Notes: [notes/sky-geo.md](../notes/sky-geo.md). Sync locally: `node scripts/sync.mjs --category sky-geo`
